name: Intel RealSense D457
description: IP65 version of the D455 (95 mm baseline active stereo, global-shutter RGB, IMU) that streams over GMSL2 through a FAKRA connector instead of USB.

specs.label: Depth
specs.value: Active IR stereo (D450 module), up to 1280 × 720; FOV 87° H × 58° V × 95° D (HD)

specs.label: Range
specs.value: 0.4 m to over 10 m (varies with lighting); min-Z 520 mm @ 1280 × 720

specs.label: RGB
specs.value: OmniVision OV9782, up to 1280 × 800, global shutter

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: GMSL2 over FAKRA (Amphenol 095-820-109-05C, C-coding, blue); USB-C for debug/production only

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 12 V (10.8–13.2 V) over FAKRA, 300 mA nominal

features.label: Imagers / emitters (camera masking view)
features.value: Stereo imagers (95.00) mm apart; the other openings are (59.00) and (37.50) mm from the right-hand imager; 47.50 ±0.10 mm from the 1/4-20 centerline to the left imager. Imagers sit (14.50) mm above the bottom in the side view.

features.label: Rear mounting
features.value: 2× M4, 61.50 mm apart, with screw thread inserts, max insertion depth 6 mm, max torque 3.0 N·m (tested with M4 class 8.8 SHCS); rear mounting surface flatness 0.1 mm

features.label: Bottom mounting
features.value: 1× 1/4"-20, max insertion depth 9 mm, screw torque 6 ft-lb (8.1 N·m)

features.label: Connectors
features.value: FAKRA (GMSL) plug on the rear; reference dims (43) and (57.6) mm from the 1/4-20 centerline to the FAKRA boss; (9.50) mm side-view offset. USB-C (debug) with 2× M2 cable screw-lock points; external sync connector and GMSL/USB boot switch on the top

amazon.title: Intel - 82635DSD457 - Intel RealSense Depth Camera D457 - Box

notes: Do not reuse the D455 mesh: the D457 housing is 36 mm deep (D455 is 26 mm) and its rear M4 holes are 61.5 mm apart (D455: 95 mm). Datasheet D457 Aug 2025 (337029-011). Range text says 0.4 m to over 10 m, while the D400 datasheet gives 0.4–6 m for the D455 with the same module.
